members.bio: Raham co-founded Connexiba with a background in corporate finance, valuation and commercial strategy for technology and growth-stage businesses. His experience spans financial modelling, market analysis and guiding companies from early-stage through to sustainable growth, working closely with executive teams on capital structure, strategic direction and long-term business building. At Connexiba, Raham brings that same commercial discipline to how the company grows — combining financial rigor with a clear focus on market expansion, partnerships and the strategic decisions that help technology and B2B businesses scale with confidence.

Ali brings more than fifteen years of international business development experience across technology, SaaS and B2B commercial environments. His background spans the full commercial cycle — from identifying market opportunities and building targeted outreach, to developing relationships with senior decision-makers and closing new business. At Connexiba, Ali focuses on connecting solution providers with the executive audiences and commercial opportunities that matter most to their growth, drawing on years of experience building relationships and driving revenue across international technology and B2B markets.
members.alt: Ali Ebtekar — Head of Business Development

members.bio: Lana leads marketing at Connexiba, shaping how the company communicates its work to technology and B2B audiences. Her focus is on turning Connexiba's commercial expertise into clear, executive-relevant messaging — from brand positioning and content to the campaigns that support audience development and engagement. Working closely with the wider team, Lana helps ensure that Connexiba's marketing consistently reflects its commercial focus: reaching the right decision-makers with the right message, and presenting Connexiba's approach in a way that resonates with technology-driven businesses and the executives they're trying to reach.

experience.p1: Connexiba is built on more than fifteen years of hands-on commercial and business-development experience across technology and SaaS sales, executive-level engagement and B2B business development in international markets — identifying and connecting solution providers with the decision-makers genuinely relevant to their commercial objective.
